user.title: Connect to the Bbox router
user.description: Enter the address of your router and its administration credentials. The password is stored by Home Assistant and never appears in a configuration file.

reauth_confirm.title: Password required
reauth_confirm.description: The router rejected the connection. Please enter the administration password again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the router at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The router rejected the username or password.
error.already_connected: An administration session is already open on the router (web interface or another instance). Close it, or wait a few minutes, then try again.

settings.title: Bbox options
settings.description:
Integration settings.

• under_box (default): all client entities are attached to the Bbox device.
• separate: each client becomes its own Home Assistant device.

You can still make individual devices independent via the « Independent device » switch.

Dashboards: select one or more variants to create in the sidebar (refresh the page after saving).

data.dashboards: Dashboards to create in the sidebar

parental_add.title: New parental-control profile
parental_add.description: A profile groups the devices of one person (phone, tablet, console…). They share the same bedtime windows and daily quota, which you then set from the profile's entities. The profile starts switched off.

parental_remove.title: Remove a profile
parental_remove.description: Devices blocked by this profile are released.

device_names.title: Rename a device
device_names.description: Pick the device whose name you want to change. The name replaces the router's one everywhere (entities, dashboards, alerts).

device_names_form.title: Device name
device_names_form.description: {device}\n\nLeave empty to go back to the router's name.

error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-reads the state of the router.

block_device.name: Block a device
block_device.description: Blocks a device on the router network.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the device to block.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the device to release.

set_wifi.name: Toggle Wi-Fi
set_wifi.description: Turns the router Wi-Fi on or off.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: true to turn on, false to turn off.

wake_device.name: Wake a device
wake_device.description: Sends a magic packet (Wake-on-LAN) to power the device on.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the device to wake.

set_internet_access.name: Cut Internet access of a device
set_internet_access.description: Cuts (or restores) the Internet output of a device, Wi-Fi or wired. The device keeps its IP address and stays reachable on the local network.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the device concerned.

allowed.name: Access allowed
allowed.description: false to cut Internet access, true to restore it.

set_wifi_access.name: Allow or deny Wi-Fi of a device
set_wifi_access.description: Adds the device to the black list of its Wi-Fi network (it is disconnected), or removes it.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the device concerned.

allowed.name: Access allowed
allowed.description: false to disconnect from Wi-Fi, true to reconnect.

create_dashboard.name: Create / update dashboards
create_dashboard.description: Creates the selected Bbox dashboards in the sidebar (storage mode).

dashboards.name: Dashboards
dashboards.description: One or more variants: native, auto, mushroom.

grant_extra_time.name: Grant extra time
grant_extra_time.description: Lifts the parental-control restrictions (schedule and quota) of a profile, or of one of its devices, for a while.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Duration of the override (default 60). 0 cancels a running override.

device.name: Device
device.description: Name or MAC address of one device of the profile. Leave empty for the whole profile.

add_quota_time.name: Add quota time
add_quota_time.description: Adds minutes to today's quota of a device (or of every device of the profile that has a quota). The bonus ends at midnight.

device.name: Device
device.description: Name or MAC address of one device of the profile. Leave empty for the whole profile.

wifi_timer.name: Wi-Fi timer
wifi_timer.description: Switches a Wi-Fi band on now and off again after a while. The timer survives a restart of Home Assistant. 0 minutes cancels a running timer.

band.name: Band
band.description: Which Wi-Fi to switch (the guest network is only available where the box exposes it).
